sentences.text: The name Arenipiscis means "sand fish" because its armor has a granular texture created by tiny bumps on the dermal surfaces.
Young described the genus Arenipiscis in 1981, noting that the only known species is Arenipiscis westolli. The holotype specimen, identified as ANU 35616, consists of an incomplete skull roof.
Arenipiscis belongs to the parent group Arthrodira and is classified in the class Placodermi.
Arenipiscis lived during the Emsian stage, between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
